mentions.name: Quell
mentions.description: This service gives users an SMS number for putting boundaries around communication with someone who is blowing up their phone. Incoming texts are intelligently filtered so hostility is removed while information is preserved, and all raw texts are also routed to email for record-keeping and rewrite verification.
mentions.problem: Broken relationships can be difficult and nerve-wracking, especially when someone is blowing up your phone and making your life hard.
mentions.audience: Individuals whose phone is being blown up by someone making their life hard
mentions.source_excerpt:
Quell (textquell.com)

Broken relationships can be difficult and nerve-wracking. Quell gives you an SMS number that enables you to put boundaries around your communication with someone who is blowing up your phone and making your life hard. Their texts are intelligently filtered so that hostility is removed while information is preserved. All raw texts are also routed to email for record-keeping and rewrite verification.
